criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bespoke test passed; 1 and 3 strongest; 2 decal flies and a dark blob; 9 dowel support and flat pasture; 5 marching ants and a pail; 7 abstract and top loaded; 4 mannequin.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine and accent hold; glass motif works; 6 and 7 furthest from the vocabulary.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: No hard fail. Looser phrasings: slide 6 'Models from USDA's lab in Kerrville' an inference from c19 and 'already plans the release' stronger than c17; slide 4 universal set over APHIS's traps; caption 'None of it is built yet' broader than c6; slide 2 'sterile female' against c23; 120 cases relayed.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, why, where and when clear; no action today.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 6 and 7 detours.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; 'Drawn to illustrate' nine times; generic closing question.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 54 on October 18th told the same parasite with the same Kerrville models and Edinburg figure, 32 days ago; slides 5 and 6 reuse its claims.

one_sentence_fix: Replace slides 5 and 6 with frames built on c13 and c14, the surveillance system and the smartphone report.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Squared caliche block, phone flat on the plank plane facing the glass, world scaled grain, camera lower so the bulb sits on cobalt.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Decal flies, dark blob, lavender plastic block.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Flies standing on rims with contact shadows, delete the blob, brushed metal with a lit chamfer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Marching ants stream, pail trap, acacia tree.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Depth banded near flies with wings, funnel cone and lure cap, a twisted multi trunk mesquite.
Lower and push the camera, run a drag scuff from the slot to the pulled box.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Worker at the bench with forceps under a warm lamp pool, warmer walls.
